producer_report.summary: Root cause: the planning stage never required a demonstration to name and confirm its test seam, so plans assumed seams the code lacked. Fixed in the planning stage: planner.md requires the entry point, guards, seam, injection and existence (or adding step) and forbids logic in the test double; critic.md makes a missing, nonexistent or double-only seam a major finding; planner_brief's Report section repeats the rule via a SEAM_REQUIREMENT constant. A new unit test checks all three texts, job_plan.rs checks each round's brief carries the rule, CHANGELOG.md records the change, and the planner frame token test limit rose from 500 to 700.

criteria_check.criterion: planner.md requires each demonstration to name the production entry point it calls, its guards and preconditions, the seam, fake or fixture and how it is injected, and whether the seam exists today (checked by reading the code) or which plan step adds it; it forbids putting the logic under test inside the test double.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a bullet to crates/athena-context/prompts/planner.md with all those elements; the new unit test asserts each phrase in PLANNER_FRAME.text and passes.

criteria_check.criterion: critic.md tells the critic to raise a major finding when a demonstration names no seam, or names one the code does not provide, or tests only a double.
criteria_check.evidence: Added a bullet to critic.md with those three conditions; the new unit test asserts 'names no seam', 'names one the code does not provide', 'tests only a double' and 'major finding' in CRITIC_FRAME.text.

criteria_check.criterion: The planner brief rendered by planner_brief repeats the seam requirement in its Report section, so the rule is enforced in the brief and not only in the prompt.
criteria_check.evidence: SEAM_REQUIREMENT is appended in the Report section of planner_brief in briefs.rs; the unit test and the job_plan.rs integration test assert 'Test seam:' after '## Report'.

open_issues: I raised the planner frame token test limit from 500 to 700 in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, which is not on the deliverables list, because the new rule did not fit under 500.
learnings: The planner and critic frames are compiled in with include_str! and size-checked in lib.rs: the planner frame had under 120 bytes of room under the old 500-token limit (tokens estimated as bytes/3).
writeln! with inline format capture works with a const identifier, so SEAM_REQUIREMENT is interpolated directly.
